title: 彭博Lansing：韩台稳市措施，为何难获市场认可？
speaker: Lansing (Landing) Too

segments.en: Let's talk a bit more about what's going on this morning landing. We're starting to see some stable as-emasion measures coming through from Korea, from Taiwan, from China.
segments.zh: 我们再聊聊今早的情况。韩国、台湾和内地市场开始出现一些稳定措施。

segments.en: How far do you think these sort of measures will go in terms of stabilizing these markets?
segments.zh: 你认为这些措施能在多大程度上稳定市场？

segments.en: Yeah. I think these measures are considered not enough by most of the investors that we spoke to.
segments.zh: 是的，我们接触的大多数市场参与者认为这些措施还不够。

segments.en: Just because, first of all, if you look at China, that margin, a reduction versus margin, a reduction.
segments.zh: 首先，看看内地市场，保证金调整与下调之间的反复。

segments.en: That kind of flip-flop has been going on for a while, and we really didn't think markets is paying much attention to that.
segments.zh: 这种反复已经持续一段时间，我们认为市场并未太关注。

segments.en: It doesn't move the fundamental needle here.
And for Taiwan and Korea, I think a lot of pressure really comes from foreigners' dashing for the door, right?
segments.zh: 对于台湾和韩国，压力主要来自外资撤离。

segments.en: They are really trying to preserve the little profit they probably still have on the table for the remainder of the year.
segments.zh: 他们试图保住年内可能仅剩的利润。

segments.en: So I think it's really coming down to whether hedge funds will continue to cut exposure, whether there will be deep buyers coming into these markets.
segments.zh: 所以关键在于对冲基金是否会继续减少敞口，以及是否有深度买家入场。

segments.en: Today, we are seeing some kind of stabilization in Taiwan a little bit.
segments.zh: 今天，我们看到台湾市场略有企稳。

segments.en: In Korea, still down, but not as much as the market has feared.
segments.zh: 韩国市场仍在下跌，但跌幅没有市场担心的那么大。

segments.en: So I can see investors are kind of doing a little bit of recovery calibration to see at those levels, whether it's actually worth coming in.
segments.zh: 所以我能看到市场参与者在做一些修复性的校准，看看在这些水平上是否真的值得入场。

segments.en: So it takes a lot of courage, actually, to do that at this time.
segments.zh: 所以在这个时候这样做实际上需要很大的勇气。
